$description: Tasty Design System — W3C DTCG token export. 3 tiers: primitive → semantic → component. Aliases ({tier.key}) mirror the CSS var() chain. Theme-scoped primitives & semantic role-remaps carry a Latte value under $extensions["com.tasty.mode"].latte; baseline $value is Catppuccin Mocha. Generated from tokens/{primitives,semantic,components}.css — full parity, do not hand-edit.
